title: Peer review of the Colab 'Hybrid Sovereign Mesh' run, and corrected analyses on the same committed datasets (pre-registered and hash-locked BEFORE the audit runner existed)
what_this_is: A referee report with executable checks. Every numeric claim in the Colab output is recomputed from the committed source files and assigned one of four verdicts: REPRODUCED (matches within tolerance), NOT_REPRODUCED (recomputes to a different value), INVALID (arithmetically fine but the construct is unsound), or CIRCULAR (true by construction and therefore not evidence). Where a claim is INVALID or CIRCULAR, a corrected analysis is specified here in advance so the correction cannot be shaped by its own result.
datasets_committed: All nine uploaded files are committed under data/colab-audit/ with a SHA-256 manifest, so this review reproduces offline forever. The original Colab run read files that were not committed anywhere; that alone made it unreviewable.

audit_gates.A1_banking_shock_reproduces: Recompute debits (Transaction Type == Debit, Account Balance > 0) and the count with Transaction Amount / Account Balance > 0.30. PASS iff exactly 4886 debits and 400 high-risk, as claimed. CAN FAIL.
audit_gates.A2_meezan_headline_numbers_reproduce: Recompute the four Risk-Sharing figures under the Colab's own method: n, mean capacity, zombie breach rate, mean effective yield. PASS iff all four match the claimed 11248 / 238959.66 / 26.64% / 104378.76 within 0.01. CAN FAIL.
audit_gates.A3_kenya_index_reproduces: Recompute the demand index with the Colab's keyword list and denominator. PASS iff it equals the claimed 11.24% within 0.05pp. CAN FAIL, and is EXPECTED TO FAIL -- the denominator counts every spreadsheet row rather than respondents.
audit_gates.A4_executive_order_capacity_counts_repro: Recompute executive-order counts by PAP majortopic for Macroeconomics(1), Banking(15), Defense(16), Government Operations(20). PASS iff exactly 112 / 132 / 907 / 1061. CAN FAIL.
audit_gates.A5_legislative_D_dec_reproduces: Recompute congressional-hearing counts by the same four majortopics. PASS iff exactly 3567 / 8245 / 11404 / 15738. CAN FAIL.
audit_gates.A6_legislative_D_enc_reproduces: Recompute mean statutory description length by the same four majortopics. PASS iff within 1.0 of the claimed 117.59 / 91.05 / 196.88 / 91.31. CAN FAIL, and is EXPECTED TO FAIL.
audit_gates.A7_the_risk_sharing_cohort_actually_cont: Inspect Contract_Type in the Meezan file. The Colab labels Ijara+Murabaha+Salam as the 'Risk-Sharing (Data)' cohort. Risk-sharing in the Islamic-finance sense means profit-and-loss partnership: mudarabah and musharakah. PASS iff the cohort contains at least one mudarabah or musharakah contract. CAN FAIL, and is EXPECTED TO FAIL -- which would mean the cohort labelled 'risk-sharing' contains none, and the headline comparison tests something other than what it names.
audit_gates.A8_the_debt_comparison_is_not_rigged: Examine whether the 'Synthetic Debt' arm is a measurement or a tuned simulation. PASS iff its capacity, base fidelity and hop distribution are derived from data rather than set to target values. CAN FAIL, and is EXPECTED TO FAIL -- the published source sets capacity_u to a 'Target Mean Capacity', base_fidelity_d to a 'Tuned' constant, and the hop distribution to 'Tuned', while the comparison arm uses a different fidelity constant.
audit_gates.A9_zombie_breach_is_not_a_relabelled_qua: The zombie breach rate is defined as P(base_fidelity ** Risk_Score < 0.50), which is algebraically P(Risk_Score > ln(0.5)/ln(0.95)) = P(Risk_Score > 13.513). PASS iff the reported breach rate DIFFERS from that raw quantile. CAN FAIL, and is EXPECTED TO FAIL, in which case the statistic is a renamed percentile of an input column and carries no independent information.
audit_gates.A10_legislative_fidelity_is_dimensionall: In E = U * D, D is a fidelity and must lie in [0,1] for the product to be interpretable. The Colab reports D values of 419450.43, 750698.13, 2245229.40 and 1437080.37, formed by multiplying a mean character count by a raw hearing count. PASS iff every reported D lies in [0,1]. CAN FAIL, and is EXPECTED TO FAIL.

correction_gates.C1_contracts_are_classified_by_their_act: Reclassify the Meezan contracts by whether they transfer ownership risk: mudarabah/musharakah = risk-sharing; murabaha/ijara/salam = sale-, lease- and forward-based, i.e. debt-like in payoff even when Sharia-compliant in form. Report the true composition. DECLARED falsifiable:false -- it is a taxonomy correction, not a finding, and is EXCLUDED from the score.
correction_gates.C2_a_fair_like_for_like_comparison_repla: Compare payoff structures on THE SAME transactions with THE SAME fidelity parameter, varying only the contract form. No arm may use a fidelity constant the other does not. PASS iff the two arms differ in structure alone and the reported difference is computed rather than targeted. CAN FAIL if the datasets do not support a matched comparison.
correction_gates.C3_legislative_fidelity_is_rebuilt_in_[0: Rebuild D_enc as normalised statutory specificity (mean description length divided by the maximum across domains) and D_dec as verification INTENSITY (hearings per enacted law, normalised to its maximum), so both lie in [0,1] and D = D_enc * D_dec does too. PASS iff every rebuilt D lies in (0,1]. CAN FAIL.
correction_gates.C4_a_real_legislative_tau_v_is_measured_: The Colab asserts a '69-day' and '~70-day' enforcement latency without ever computing one from these files. public_laws.csv carries date_introduced and date_signed. Compute the actual median days from introduction to signature per domain. PASS iff a median latency is computed for all four domains from at least 100 dated laws each. CAN FAIL. The pre-registered expectation is that the true median is FAR larger than 69 days, which would refute the asserted figure.
correction_gates.C5_the_corrected_yield_ordering_is_repor: With D rebuilt in [0,1], recompute E = U * D per domain and report the ordering. DECLARED SYMMETRIC: the corrected ordering may agree or disagree with the Colab's, and either outcome is reported at full force. PASS iff the ordering is computed and reported; the gate does not require any particular ordering. falsifiable:false -- it is a reporting obligation, EXCLUDED from the score.
correction_gates.C6_capacity_and_fidelity_are_not_the_sam: If D_dec is a raw count of oversight actions, it grows with domain size and is therefore a capacity measure, making E = U*D approximately U-squared and the comparison circular. Test whether the REBUILT D (an intensity, not a count) is decorrelated from U: PASS iff |spearman(U, D_rebuilt)| < 0.90 across domains. CAN FAIL.

symmetric_null: Every recomputed value is reported with its exact figure whether or not it agrees with the Colab. Gates A3, A6, A7, A8, A9 and A10 are all EXPECTED TO FAIL and are written that way in advance; a pass on any of them would mean the criticism was wrong and must be withdrawn. C1 and C5 are declared non-falsifiable and excluded from the score. No threshold in this file may move after the lock.
what_this_review_does_not_do: It does not claim the Colab author acted in bad faith; tuned baselines and dimensionally loose proxies are ordinary early-stage modelling errors. It does not claim Islamic finance is better or worse than conventional finance -- that question is not answerable from these files. It does not validate the Hybrid Sovereign Mesh or any political decentralisation claim; those require the corrected analyses to survive, and the corrections are specified here before their results are known.
acceptance: GREEN when this spec re-hashes to its published canonical SHA-256, every committed dataset matches its manifest hash, and all gates are evaluated exactly as written -- with expected failures recorded as failures and corrections reported whatever they show. Exit 0 means 'the review reproduces, including the claims it refutes', never 'the Colab was validated'.
